priorityList: Ensure Shadowform is active at all times.
Maintain Vampiric Touch on all targets (up to 12) to enable your cleave and resource generation.
Cast Voidform (Entropic Rift) as soon as your primary dots are applied to targets.
Cast Power Infusion and Halo on cooldown, ideally overlapping with your Voidform/Entropic Rift window.
Priority: Cast Void Volley and Void Blast as the highest priority whenever they are available during Entropic Rift.
Cast Shadow Word: Madness (replaces Devouring Plague) if you are about to cap Insanity, to refresh its DoT, or if you have a Mind Devourer proc.
Cast Tentacle Slam to refresh Vampiric Touch on your target or if you are about to reach 2 charges.
Cast Void Torrent as a high priority channel, but only if Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain are already active on your targets.
Cast Mind Blast to generate Insanity and prevent charge capping.
Use Mind Flay: Insanity procs as your primary filler.
Cast Shadow Word: Death on targets below 20% health or while your Shadowfiend/Mindbender is active.
Use offensive Trinkets and Potions during Power Infusion or Voidform for maximum benefit.
Channel Mind Flay as your final filler if no other abilities are available.
